title: The Blueprint of the Post Road
offer: Agent — nobody's ever mapped where the letters actually GO once they leave my hands. Walk the route with me — talk to the folk who post it, the courier who carries it.
nextHint: Find Bram in the Village Square
debrief: Map the flows, find the flow nobody drew, and encrypt what travels — no more, no less.

steps.objective: Interview Bram about the mail's route (press E)
Interview a villager at the square (press E)
Interview the courier near the gates (press E)
steps.toast: HERALD — Every system has a map, Ranger — the one they drew, and the one they actually run.

steps.objective: Draw the blueprint of the post road
